untestable_routes.donor: The activity rows have no donor identifier.
untestable_routes.fitted-preprocessing: The table holds measurements rather than a fitted transformation, so a preprocessing step fitted on the test set cannot be observed here.
untestable_routes.patient: The activity rows have no patient identifier.
untestable_routes.site: The activity rows have no collection site identifier.
untestable_routes.target-family: The activity rows carry a target identifier and not a protein family, and the snapshot carries no target-to-family mapping, so a route through a family of related targets cannot be measured here.
untestable_routes.temporal: The activity rows have no measurement date.
